did.unittitle: Office of the Messrs. Rockefeller records, Documents, Series S

physdesc.extent: 90 containers including: 84 legal documents, 5 letter documents, and 1 half-legal document box.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents note
scopecontent.p: The material in Series S includes deeds, mortgages, and plats covering property once owned by John D. Rockefeller and John D. Rockefeller, Jr. in New York, Maine, New Jersey, Ohio, Massachusetts, Illinois, Georgia, and Virginia. There also are expired powers of attorney, as well as some appraisals of real estate and personal property, including properties of select members of the third and fourth generations of the Rockefeller family.

acqinfo.head: Immediate Source of Acquisition
acqinfo.p: Series S was accessioned by the Rockefeller family archives as 1964:003.

arrangement.head: Arrangement
arrangement.p: Arranged in 3 series as follows: 1. John D. Rockefeller, Jr. Deed File (which is further arranged by place); 2. Maine Lands; 3. Rockefeller Family Property and Agreements.
Records remain in original order, as received.

accessrestrict.head: Conditions Governing Access
accessrestrict.p: Open for research. Brittle or damaged items are available at the discretion of RAC.
